components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Lexer state machine
components.responsibility: Consume characters once with state CODE, SINGLE, DOUBLE, LINE or BLOCK; preserve one pending delimiter character across chunks.

components.label: Pending lookahead
components.responsibility: Hold at most one undecided /, -, quote or block-star until the next code unit or explicit EOF resolves it.

components.label: Quote transitions
components.responsibility: Enter matching quote state from CODE; copy characters verbatim and treat delimiter bytes only as literal content while quoted.

components.label: Escape handling
components.responsibility: Backslash copies the following code unit literally; doubled matching quotes remain inside the same literal.

components.label: Line comment state
components.responsibility: On // or -- emit one separator then discard until CR or LF; copy newline code units and return to CODE.

components.label: Block comment state
components.responsibility: After /* emit one separator, drop nonnewline content until first */; internal /* is plain comment content.

components.label: Output sink
components.responsibility: Append the opener separator and retained newlines to a terminal-owned output sink; never join lexical tokens across removed comments.

components.label: EOF transition
components.responsibility: Flush ordinary pending characters, finish a line comment at EOF, and reject BLOCK or unclosed quote state. Mark finished exactly once.

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Span tokenizer
components.responsibility: Retain the source, tokenize nonoverlapping literal/comment/plain spans, then reconstruct from source slices and comment whitespace.

components.label: Immutable source buffer
components.responsibility: Read the entire input into an immutable source and use half-open code-unit ranges.

components.label: Literal-span scanner
components.responsibility: At a quote, scan matching delimiter with escapes/doubled-quote rules and emit a literal span without scanning its body for comments.

components.label: Line-span scanner
components.responsibility: At CODE // or -- record through the last nonnewline character; leave CR/LF to the next plain span.

components.label: Block-span scanner
components.responsibility: At CODE /* search the first */ while counting newlines for diagnostics; reject EOF with no closer.

components.label: Ordered span list
components.responsibility: Append adjacent disjoint spans covering source exactly once; keep original start/end and span kind.

components.label: Whitespace reconstruction
components.responsibility: Copy plain/literal slices; replace each comment with one space plus its original CR/LF code units. Record emitted intervals for source mapping.

components.label: Atomic result boundary
components.responsibility: Validate every span and EOF state before joining output pieces; errors report original opener offset without returning a successful partial result.

requirements.text: Keep comment-looking delimiters inside quoted literals unchanged; respect escaped and doubled quotes.
Carry block/quote/line state across chunks; two-character delimiters can straddle chunks.
Preserve line boundaries and token separation; reject unterminated block comments or quoted strings explicitly at EOF.

problem.scope: Authored local lexer for a deliberately small language: // and -- line comments, nonnested /* */ blocks, single/double quoted strings, backslash escapes and doubled quote escapes. Preserve newline characters and replace each comment with separating whitespace to prevent token joining. No regex literals, template interpolation, nested comments, dollar quoting or full SQL dialect claim.
problem.studyLabel: Comment stripping with explicit lexical states

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

references.supports: SQL line/block delimiters and comments as whitespace. This authored lexer additionally supports // and backslash escapes.
references.title: SQLite comments

evidence.testName: batch-07 lexer: delimiters quotes chunks and token separation

acceptanceCases.given: Quoted delimiters, escaped quotes, doubled quotes, // and -- lines, and multiline blocks.
acceptanceCases.then: Outputs match; strings remain byte-for-byte; comment text disappears while newlines and separating whitespace remain.
acceptanceCases.when: Feed whole input and every possible two-chunk split to both implementations.

acceptanceCases.given: The sequences /*/, ///*, a*/b, and an unterminated string.
acceptanceCases.then: /*/ reports unterminated block; ///* is a line comment; a*/b is ordinary text; unterminated strings report an error.

guarantees: A single pass with bounded pending state; quoted content and newlines are preserved.

apis.errors: finish throws SyntaxError for unterminated block or quoted literal; feed after finish rejects
apis.request: {"operation":"feed|finish","chunk":"string of Unicode code units","grammar":"fixed declared subset"}
apis.response: {"output":"comment-free text preserving newlines and token separation","diagnostic":"unterminated block|string or none"}

assumptions: Text indices and source offsets use UTF-16 code units. No nested comment interpretation; block closes at the first */. Lexer subset is pinned, not guessed from file extension.

stages.reason: Append the opener separator and retained newlines to a terminal-owned output sink; never join lexical tokens across removed comments.

invariants: EOF is explicit and independent from chunk completion.

tradeoffs: Boundary handling is more intricate than a whole-buffer scan.
